changes.text: 魏公子无忌带着百余乘车骑出了魏都大梁，准备去秦军阵前拼命，与赵国同归于尽。车过城东的夷门，他停下来见守门的老人侯嬴，把这打算原原本本告诉了他。侯嬴只送了一句「公子勉之矣，老臣不能從」。车队走出几里，《史记》写无忌「心不快」；他掉转车头，回来问侯嬴。

Prince Wuji of Wei rode out of Daliang, the Wei capital, with a hundred-odd chariots and horsemen, intending to hurl himself at the Qin army and die alongside the state of Zhao. Passing the Yimen, the eastern gate of the city, he stopped to see Hou Ying, the aged gatekeeper there, and told him the plan outright. Hou Ying saw him off with a single line — "Push on, my lord; I am old and cannot follow you". The column had gone a few li when the Records of the Grand Historian has Wuji "troubled in his heart"; he turned the chariots around and came back to question Hou Ying.

司马迁怎么看待此事？太史公说自己过大梁，特意去寻夷门；他称无忌为信陵君，说无忌结交岩穴隐者、不耻下交，「名冠諸侯，不虛耳」。作者认为，这份褒扬落在无忌敬重侯嬴这类隐士的一端，而不在矫令杀将上。此后的经过是：无忌留赵十年，后来秦攻魏，他在赵国结交的隐士毛公、薛公劝他：公子在赵国受重视、名闻诸侯，「徒以有魏也」——只因背后有魏国。他立刻归国为将，率五国之兵破秦；秦用重金收买晋鄙的门客毁谤他，魏王果然派人代将，他谢病饮酒，四年后病酒而死。他死后秦攻魏，拔二十城，此后十八年，秦国俘虏了魏国后来的国君。一种解释是，这段收尾把无忌的存亡与魏国的存亡写在了一起。

What did Sima Qian make of it? The Grand Historian writes that he passed through Daliang and made a point of finding the Yimen. Calling Wuji by his title, Lord Xinling, he says Wuji's readiness to seek out recluses in mountain caves and to befriend men beneath him had good cause, and that his name stood first among the lords — no empty fame. One reading is that this praise lands on the end where Wuji honored recluses like Hou Ying, not on the forged order and the slain general. What came afterward ran as follows. Wuji stayed in Zhao ten years. When Qin attacked Wei, Master Mao and Master Xue, two recluses he had befriended in Zhao, told him that he was valued in Zhao and known among the lords only because he had Wei behind him. He went home at once to command Wei's army and led the forces of five states to defeat Qin. Qin then spent heavy sums of gold buying off Jin Pi's former retainers to slander him; the king of Wei did send a replacement to take over the army, and Wuji excused himself on illness and took to drink, dying of it four years later. After his death Qin attacked Wei and took twenty cities, and eighteen years later captured a later king of Wei. On one interpretation, this closing episode writes Wuji's survival and Wei's survival on the same line.

dispositions.rationale: 英文删去多出的“whether he had failed him in some way”，改为“came back to question Hou Ying”。这样与中文“回来问侯嬴”一致，也消除了 he/him 的指代含混。中文字段未改动，按中英同步规则一并给出全文。
原句“代价也没有就此结束”以事实语气把后来的经过定为救赵的代价。现改为中性的“此后的经过是”（英文 What came afterward ran as follows），只叙述证据所载的先后经过，因果判断留给段末“一种解释是”。

evidence.quote: 乃行金萬斤於魏，求晉鄙客，令毀公子於魏王
秦聞公子死，使蒙驁攻魏，拔二十城
